purpose: Test whether the robust Gate006 A4 advantage survives when the matched Hadamard dynamic-A4 baseline is granted the exact pre-quantization token RMS at every residual boundary.

frozen_protocol.calibration_transfer: WikiText validation only; frozen unchanged for C4

primary_rules.exact_angular_independent_value: On each corpus, angular_A4_exact_radius NLL < dynamic_A4_exact_RMS_restored NLL and paired-bootstrap 95% upper CI of the per-sequence NLL difference is < 0.
primary_rules.practical_log4_independent_value: On each corpus, angular_A4_log4_radius NLL < dynamic_A4_exact_RMS_restored NLL and paired-bootstrap 95% upper CI is < 0.
primary_rules.codec_fidelity: On each corpus, angular_A4_log4_radius NLL <= angular_A4_exact_radius NLL + 0.10.
primary_rules.robust_pass: All three rules pass on both corpora.

interpretation_boundary: A pass isolates value in the shared/fixed angular representation beyond mere restoration of token RMS. It does not establish speed, energy efficiency, or novelty for shape-gain decomposition itself.

literature_boundary.BitNet_v2: Hadamard transforms are established for native A4 activations in 1-bit LLMs.
literature_boundary.FPTQuant: Function-preserving residual scaling and dynamic scaling are prior art for quantization-friendly activation shaping.
literature_boundary.KVarN: Token-scale preservation with Hadamard/normalization is established for KV-cache quantization, not this residual-stream intervention.
